title: Beautiful vintage Le Creuset enamelled cast iron baking dish 30
description:
Beautiful vintage Le Creuset enamelled cast iron baking dish in the iconic volcanic orange color 🧡

A timeless French kitchen classic, perfect for collectors or everyday use. This large size 30 dish is in great vintage condition, with a very clean interior and lovely glossy enamel. The piece measures approximately 30 cm long, 20 cm wide and around 6 cm high.

Made in France and marked Le Creuset on the base.
A beautiful and practical piece with that authentic vintage charm Le Creuset lovers appreciate.

As with all vintage items, please check pictures carefully for condition details.
